content:
ria: Heads up — Sales pushed for a "hotpath" rollout for ACME Corp. They want a rapid opt-in ramp with an on-call gated kill-switch. Can we plan the rollout and runbook here?

devon: Can you paste the ask from Sales? timeline and exact guardrails?

ria: Quote from AE: "Start at 5% in US-WEST for ACME-only traffic, validate latency & error gates for 30m, then go to 25% after 30m, then 50% after 2hrs if stable. Must fallback to safe-model-2025 on any spike. On-call must have one-click rollback."

sam: We already have per-tenant flags, but region-scoped overrides are only half-baked. We'll need an explicit region filter on the flag.

alex: Implementation plan: create a scoped flag `acme:hotpath` with attributes {tenant: "acme", region: "us-west", cohort_pct: 5}. Layer a control flag `hotpath-acme-all` (global kill-switch) that oncall can flip.

maria: Gate metrics: p50 <= 200ms, p95 <= 500ms, error-rate < 0.5% over 5m windows. If any breach -> immediate rollback to `safe-model-2025` + disable flag. Also require a data residency note: EU tenants must be excluded unless they explicitly opt in.

devon: Oncall runbook snippet needed here. Exact CLI to flip the kill-switch? We should add both API and console steps.

ria: Adding runbook + commands. Put these in the thread so Sales/SEs can reference.

ria: Runbook (short):
1) Watch `acme_hotpath` dashboard (latency, errors, CPU, batch size).
2) If gates fail, run: `redwood feature-flags disable hotpath-acme-all --reason "rollback: gating breach"`
3) Confirm traffic switched, monitor for 5m, then escalate to eng if persists.

ria: Console quick link: https://console.redwood.ai/flags/hotpath-acme (add to SE playbook)

alex: Example rollout config (for infra/flags service):
```yaml
flag: acme_hotpath
scopes:
  - tenant: acme
    region: "us-west"
    cohort_pct: 5
stages:
  - name: initial
    duration: 30m
    increase_to: 25
  - name: ramp-2
    duration: 90m
    increase_to: 50
fallback:
  model: safe-model-2025
  trigger_on:
    - p50_latency: ">200ms"
    - error_rate: ">0.5%"
kill_switch: hotpath-acme-all
```

sam: For telemetry/A-B: we should attach an eval set (50 prompts) to measure quality delta vs cost. Sales expects a short report after the 2hr mark. Can we auto-generate the eval snapshot?

maria: Yes — add `eval_snapshot: acme_ramp_snapshot_v1` to the experiment. Also tag traces with `acme_hotpath=true` so QA and audits can filter.

devon: Who's oncall for the ramp window? We need a committed engineer + SRE. Also add a Slack alert to #incidents and an automated pager with runbook link.

ria: Sales wants next-day ramp. Action items:
- create flag + staged rollout config (devon)
- instrument dashboard + eval snapshot (sam + maria)
- add kill-switch to console + API (alex)
- assign oncall (ria to coordinate with SRE lead)
- update SE playbook + notify AE (ria)

oncall-bot: [alert] New controlled rollout scheduled: acme_hotpath, start=2023-11-02T14:00Z, owners=@ria,@devon. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/acme-hotpath

sam: One more: A/B measurement—should we route a random 5% of traffic through hotpath but keep a shadow copy on safe-model-2025 for quality comparison? That will increase cost but gives signal.

maria: Yes, do a shadow for the first 2 hours. Make sure the privacy log notes for ACME are captured.

ria: Ok — sync 30m to finalize exact percentages & oncall lineup. I'll send calendar invite and include SE/AEs.

alex: I'll prep the kill-switch endpoint and a single-line curl for oncall: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/flags/hotpath-acme/disable -d '{"reason":"rollback"}'`

devon: I'll create the flag PR and link it in this thread when ready.

ria: Thanks everyone. Keep replies short; we need to ship the early bits today. :rocket:
